title: First Conditional (Real Possibilities)
completion_message: ¡Excelente! El Primer Condicional te permite hablar de resultados lógicos y negociar condiciones con seguridad.

parts.visual:
Usamos el Primer Condicional para hablar de situaciones reales o muy posibles en el futuro. 
Estructura: IF + Presente Simple , WILL + Verbo Base.
parts.audio: We use the First Conditional to talk about real or very possible situations in the future. The structure is: If, plus Present Simple, comma, plus Will, plus a base verb.

parts.visual:
Ejemplos: IF we drop the price, we WILL sell more (Si bajamos el precio, venderemos más). 
IF you don't call the client, they WILL cancel the order (Si no llamas al cliente, cancelarán el pedido).
parts.audio: Examples: If we drop the price, we will sell more. In negative: If you don't call the client, they will cancel the order.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta del verbo para completar la oración condicional.

questions.question: If we launch the product today, we ____ a lot of money. (Haremos).
questions.explanation: If + presente (launch), la consecuencia va con 'will' (will make).

questions.question: If you ____ the deadline, the client will be angry. (Pierdes / No cumples).
questions.explanation: La condición (después de IF) va en presente simple (miss). No se usa 'will' justo después de 'if'.

questions.question: The company ____ bankrupt if we don't reduce expenses. (Irá).
questions.explanation: La consecuencia va con 'will'. (The company will go... if we don't...).

questions.question: If she ____ the contract, we will start the project. (Firma).
questions.explanation: If + presente simple. Para 'She', el verbo lleva 's' (signs).

questions.question: If they don't accept our offer, we ____ another supplier. (Encontraremos).
If I ____ to London, I will visit their headquarters. (Voy).
questions.explanation: Condición en presente = If I go.

questions.question: If we offer a 10% discount, ____ you buy in bulk? (¿Comprarás...?).
questions.explanation: Pregunta de consecuencia en futuro: will you buy...?

questions.question: He will get promoted if he ____ this deal. (Cierra).
If the price ____ too high, customers won't buy it. (Es).
questions.explanation: If the price IS (presente del verbo be).

questions.question: If you need help with the presentation, I ____ you. (Ayudaré).
We won't reach our target if sales ____ drop. Wait, if sales DROP. (No alcanzaremos... si las ventas caen).
If the economy ____, we will expand our business. (Mejora).
questions.explanation: The economy = It -> presente simple: improves.

questions.question: What ____ you do if they reject the proposal? (¿Qué harás...?).
If we ____ early, we will avoid traffic. (Salimos).
You will lose the client if you ____ call them back today. (No llamas).
questions.explanation: Negativo en presente simple para 'you' = don't.

questions.question: If she ____ the report on time, the boss will be furious. (No entrega).
If we invest in new technology, our productivity ____ increase. (Aumentará).
They ____ agree to the terms if we compromise. (Estarán de acuerdo).
questions.explanation: They will agree (Ellos aceptarán/estarán de acuerdo).

questions.question: If the CEO ____, I will let you know. (Llega).
We ____ hire more staff unless sales go up. (Unless = If not).
questions.explanation: No contrataremos (won't hire) a menos que las ventas suban.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Completa la oración condicional con el verbo en presente o futuro ('will' + verbo).

questions.question: If we launch it today, we ____ (make) a lot of money.
If you ____ (miss) the deadline, they will be angry.
If she ____ (sign) the contract, we will start.
We ____ (find) a new supplier if they reject it.
If I ____ (go) to London, I will visit them.
If the price ____ (be) too high, they won't buy.
He will be promoted if he ____ (close) the deal.
If we ____ (leave) now, we will arrive on time.
I ____ (help) you if you need it.
If she ____ (not call), we will lose the client.

pairs.source: We will find a new supplier...
If the price is too high...

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la oración condicional correcta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If we drop the price, we will sell more.
options: If we drop the price, we will sell more.
If we drop the price, we sell more.
If we drop the price, we would sell more.
If we drop the price, we won't sell more.
questions.correct_answer: If we drop the price, we will sell more.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If you don't call, they will cancel.
options: If you don't call, they will cancel.
If you don't call, they cancel.
If you didn't call, they will cancel.
If you won't call, they will cancel.
questions.correct_answer: If you don't call, they will cancel.

questions.question: Listen carefully.

options: If she signs the contract, we will start.

If she will sign the contract, we will start.
questions.correct_answer: If she signs the contract, we will start.

questions.correct_answer: If I go to London, I will visit them.

questions.question: Listen carefully.

options: If the price is too high, they won't buy.

If the price is too high, they wouldn't buy.
If the price is too high, they will buy.
